ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of the Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme, including the individuals involved and the methods used to carry out the fraud.
questions: What was the extent of the fraud scheme?
How was the fraud carried out?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on the need for greater oversight and accountability in similar programs.
